effects.printed_clause: If Normal/Special Summoned: Special Summon Level 3 Zombie Tuner from Deck, and if you do lock Special Summons to Zombies this turn. HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Normal/Special trigger clones share HOPT, summon exact class, and only on success register non-Zombie Special Summon prohibition through End Phase.

official_references.matched_structure: Special Summons a Zombie Tuner from Deck.
Applies a Zombie-only Special Summon restriction through End Phase after successful operation.

effects.printed_clause: If sent to GY as Synchro Material: Special Summon this, banish when it leaves. HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: EVENT_BE_MATERIAL checks GY/Synchro reason, revives handler and installs leave-field removed redirect; separate HOPT.

official_references.matched_structure: Special Summon with subsequent banish/redirect state.

coverage_override.reason: The Summon-triggered Deck summon/Zombie lock and the Synchro-material self-revival/leave-field redirect are the two distinct effects; each record includes its separate HOPT.
